

```{r}
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap) # map making
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(spData) # spatial data
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(geodata) # spatial data
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
# read in raster and shapefile data
temp2008 <- rast("data 4/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
temp2009 <- rast("data 4/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
temp2010 <- rast("data 4/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
temp2011 <- rast("data 4/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
temp2012 <- rast("data 4/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")
oceandepth <- rast("data 4/depth.tif")
eezboundaries <- st_read("data 4/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```
```{r}
# test CRS's of each object to make sure they match
print(st_crs(temp2008))
print(st_crs(temp2009))
print(st_crs(temp2010)) 
print(st_crs(temp2011))
print(st_crs(temp2012))

print(st_crs(oceandepth)) 
print(st_crs(eezboundaries))


```

```{r}

# Create new raster for all 5 years
SST <- c(temp2008,temp2009, temp2010, temp2011, temp2012)
# Make sure they stacked 
plot(SST)

# Reproject depth and EEZ CRS's to make sure they match SST 
oceandepth <- project (oceandepth, SST)
eezboundaries <- st_transform(eezboundaries, crs(SST))
```


```{r}
# Find the mean SST across all 5 years
fiveyearmean <- mean(SST, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Switch the temperature to Celsius 
fiveyearmeancelsius <- fiveyearmean - 273.15
```
```{r}
# Change resolution, extent, and CRS of depth to match fiveyearmeancelsius
croppeddepth <-crop(oceandepth, fiveyearmeancelsius)
# Don't technically actually need to change resolution because project changed it already.
# croppedresdepth <- resample(croppeddepth, fiveyearmeancelsius, method="bilinear")
crs(croppeddepth) <- crs(fiveyearmeancelsius)
```


```{r}
# Make sure CRS's match so you can stack the two rasters.

if(crs(croppeddepth) == crs(fiveyearmeancelsius)){
  print("CRS's match")
}else{(warning("CRS's do not match"))
}
```
```{r}
# Make sure extents, CRS's and resolution matches before stacking rasters. 
cat("\n=== Extents of Rasters ===\n")
cat("Cropped Depth Extent:", dim(croppeddepth), "\n")
cat("Original SST Extent"); dim(fiveyearmeancelsius)
cat("CRS match"); same.crs(croppeddepth, fiveyearmeancelsius)
```

```{r}
# Stack the two rasters
tempdepth <- c(fiveyearmeancelsius, croppeddepth)
```

```{r}
plot(tempdepth)
```

```{r}
# Create a matrix for the growth levels
rcldepth <- matrix(c(
   -Inf, -70, 0, 
   -70,   0,  1,
   0,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Matrix for temperature
rcltemp <- matrix(c(
   -Inf,   11,  0,
   11,  30,  1,
  30,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Create rasters for suitable temp and suitable depth.
suitabledepth <- (classify(croppeddepth, rcl = rcldepth))
suitabletemp <- (classify(fiveyearmeancelsius, rcl = rcltemp))

# Create a vector of suitable depth and suitable temp. 
suitablezones <- c(suitabledepth, suitabletemp)

plot(suitablezones)

```

```{r}
# Find suitable areas for a species with lapp()
suitableareas <- lapp(suitablezones, fun = function(s, d) s*d)
```



```{r}
# Make suitableareas a raster
eezraster <- rasterize(eezboundaries, suitableareas, field="rgn_id")
```

```{r}
# Use cellSize function to find the total area within each EEZ zone.
suitableareascellsize <- cellSize(suitableareas, unit="km", mask=TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Mask eez to remove NAs and unsuitable zones. 
eezmasked <- mask(suitableareascellsize, suitableareas, maskvalue=0)
```

```{r}
plot(eezmasked)
```

```{r}
zone <- zonal(eezmasked, eezraster, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)

kable(zone)

map <- left_join(eezboundaries, zone, by="rgn_id")

```


## Function
```{r}

# Create function 

suitable <- function(minsst, maxsst, mindepth, maxdepth, species_name)
{
# Create a matrix for the growth levels
rcldepth <- matrix(c(
   -Inf, maxdepth, 0, 
   maxdepth,   mindepth,  1,
   mindepth,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Matrix for temperature
rcltemp <- matrix(c(
   -Inf,   minsst,  0,
   minsst,  maxsst,  1,
  maxsst,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Create rasters for suitable temp and suitable depth.
suitabledepth <- (classify(croppeddepth, rcl = rcldepth))
suitabletemp <- (classify(fiveyearmeancelsius, rcl = rcltemp))

# Create a vector of suitable depth and suitable temp. 
suitablezones <- c(suitabledepth, suitabletemp)

# Find suitable areas for a species with lapp()
suitableareas <- lapp(suitablezones, fun = function(s, d) s*d)

# Make suitableareas a raster
eezraster <- rasterize(eezboundaries, suitableareas, field="rgn_id")

# Use cellSize function to find the total area within each EEZ zone.
suitableareascellsize <- cellSize(suitableareas, unit="km", mask=TRUE)

# Mask eez to remove NAs and unsuitable zones. 
eezmasked <- mask(suitableareascellsize, suitableareas, maskvalue=0)

# Find the suitable zones in each region.
zone <- zonal(eezmasked, eezraster, fun = "sum", na.rm=TRUE)

# To make the map, first join the suitable regions by zone with the economic zone boundaries.
map <- left_join(eezboundaries, zone, by="rgn_id")

# Plot it!
plot <- tm_shape(map)+
tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
    tm_polygons(
        fill='area'
    )+
tm_title(paste("Suitable", species_name, "Habitats"))+
tm_text(text='rgn', size = 0.35)+
tm_scalebar()+
tm_add_legend(type="polygons"
)

return(plot)
}

```

```{r}
# Use function for oysters.
suitable(11, 30, 0, -70, 'oysters')
```
From this visualization, we can tell that the central California coast has the most area of suitable habitat for oysters. 

```{r}

# Use function for red abalone. 
suitable(0, 24, 0, -18, 'Red Abalone')
```
This visualization shows that the Washington coast has the most area of suitable habitat for red abalone.
